UN warns of human rights catastrophe in Sudan's El-Obeid

A United Nations human rights envoy has issued a 'red alert' regarding a catastrophe unfolding in el-Obeid, Sudan. The situation highlights severe human rights concerns in the region. This warning underscores the dire humanitarian conditions and potential for further crisis.
